name: first-children
description:
The first item of a list that is a child of the phrase, or an empty cell when none is; an empty phrase has none.

children: the phrases that may be children, in the order to try; a child is a phrase that holds every word of the phrase.

Example: semkit read --text "диван" --text "кресло" first-children "купить диван в москве,угловой диван" write -
-> диван, купить диван в москве; кресло,

The step writes its result to a new column <column>_child.

options.name: --children
options.description: the phrases that may be children, in the order to try; a child is a phrase that holds every word of the phrase. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: CHILDREN
arguments.description: the phrases that may be children, in the order to try; a child is a phrase that holds every word of the phrase. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list. The same as --children CHILDREN.
